tagline.zh: 靠极致低价做出拼多多和 Temu，2021 年退到幕后

t.en: Hangzhou to Wisconsin
t.zh: 从杭州到威斯康星

desc.en: A factory workers' son tests into Hangzhou's best schools, studies computer science at Zhejiang University and goes to the United States
desc.zh: 工人家庭的孩子一路考进杭州最好的学校，在浙江大学读计算机，随后赴美留学

t.en: Google and first startups
t.zh: 谷歌与早期创业

desc.en: Joins Google as an engineer, lunches with Warren Buffett, then leaves to start an online electronics shop and other small companies
desc.zh: 加入谷歌做工程师，跟着段永平与巴菲特吃了顿午餐，之后辞职做电商网站等小公司

t.en: Building Pinduoduo
t.zh: 创办拼多多

desc.en: Group buying inside WeChat grows from fruit sales to hundreds of millions of shoppers in under three years
desc.zh: 借助微信里的拼团，从卖水果做到数亿用户，用了不到三年

t.zh: 上市与扩张

desc.en: A Nasdaq listing, a counterfeit-goods storm, and subsidies that pull big-city shoppers onto the app
desc.zh: 纳斯达克上市、假货风波，以及把大城市用户拉进来的“百亿补贴”

t.zh: 创始人退后

desc.zh: 交出 CEO 职位，转出约三分之一持股，又在公司买家数超过阿里之际离开董事会

t.en: Temu and headwinds
t.zh: Temu 与逆风

desc.en: Temu takes the model abroad and makes him China's richest person for a few weeks; tariffs and regulators then weigh on the stock
desc.zh: Temu 把这套模式带到海外，让他一度成为中国首富；随后关税和监管压住了股价

t.en: Born in Hangzhou, Zhejiang
t.zh: 出生于浙江杭州

summary.en: Colin Huang (Huang Zheng) was born in 1980 on the outskirts of Hangzhou to parents who worked in a factory. At about twelve he was admitted to Hangzhou Foreign Language School, one of the city's most selective schools.
summary.zh: 黄峥 1980 年出生在杭州市郊，父母都是工厂工人。大约 12 岁时，他考入杭州最难进的学校之一——杭州外国语学校。

why.en: Starting point, not scored. Only the birth year is reliably public; Wikipedia lists January 1, which this file uses as a placeholder for the anchor lists. Human capital starts at a low level typical for China in 1980.
why.zh: 起点事件，不计分。公开可靠的信息只有出生年份；维基百科写的是 1 月 1 日，本文件仅把它作为各锚点序列的占位起点。人力资本以 1980 年中国的较低水平起步。

src.name: Wikipedia · Colin Huang
Forbes · Colin Huang profile

t.en: Enters the honors college of Zhejiang University
t.zh: 进入浙江大学竺可桢学院

summary.en: He was recommended for admission to Chu Kochen Honors College at Zhejiang University, where he majored in computer science.
summary.zh: 他被保送进入浙江大学竺可桢学院，主修计算机科学。

why.en: An education step: a place in the honors program of a top Chinese university raises the human-capital target. Only the year is known.
why.zh: 学历台阶：进入国内顶尖大学的荣誉学院，人力资本目标值上调。只能确认年份。

src.name: Our China Story · The unique philosophy of Pinduoduo's founder Huang Zheng
Wikipedia · Colin Huang

t.en: Earns a master's in computer science at Wisconsin–Madison
t.zh: 获威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校计算机硕士学位

summary.en: After Zhejiang University he studied in the United States and received a master's degree in computer science from the University of Wisconsin–Madison in 2004. During his studies he interned at Microsoft.
summary.zh: 从浙大毕业后他赴美留学，2004 年获得威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校计算机科学硕士学位。读书期间曾在微软实习。

why.en: An education step. A U.S. graduate degree in computer science lifts the human-capital target to about $1.5 million.
why.zh: 学历台阶。一张美国计算机硕士文凭把人力资本目标值抬到约 150 万美元。

src.name: Forbes · Colin Huang profile
Wikipedia · Colin Huang

t.en: Starts work as an engineer at Google in the United States
t.zh: 在美国加入谷歌任工程师

summary.en: He began his career at Google in 2004, the year the company went public, working as a software engineer and later a project manager.
summary.zh: 2004 年他在谷歌开始职业生涯，先做软件工程师，后来做项目经理。那一年正是谷歌上市之年。

why.en: First job and first savings, so the private-wealth series starts here. Reports say his Google shares gave him financial independence; the model uses a rough estimate of a few million dollars by 2007.
why.zh: 第一份工作和第一笔积蓄，私有财富序列从这里开始。有报道称谷歌股票让他实现了财务自由；模型粗略估算到 2007 年为几百万美元。

fin.zh: 私有财富序列起步（估算）。

src.name: Forbes · Colin Huang profile
Wikipedia · Colin Huang

t.en: Returns to China to help set up Google's operations there
t.zh: 回国参与组建谷歌中国

summary.en: In 2006 he moved back to China as part of the team, led by Kai-Fu Lee, that expanded Google's services in the country.
summary.zh: 2006 年他回到国内，加入李开复带领的团队，参与谷歌在中国的业务拓展。

why.en: A career step with no priced effect. It gave him first-hand experience of the Chinese internet market shortly before he left to start his own company.
why.zh: 职业台阶，没有可定价的财务影响。这段经历让他在创业前近距离接触了中国互联网市场。

src.name: Wikipedia · Colin Huang

t.en: Joins Duan Yongping at the charity lunch with Warren Buffett
t.zh: 随段永平出席巴菲特慈善午餐

summary.en: Electronics entrepreneur Duan Yongping, a fellow Zhejiang University alumnus, won the 2006 charity auction for lunch with Warren Buffett with a bid of $620,100 and took the 26-year-old Huang along. Huang later said the meal taught him the value of simplicity and common sense, and has called Duan his most important mentor.
summary.zh: 同为浙大校友的企业家段永平以 62.01 万美元拍下 2006 年的巴菲特慈善午餐，并带上了 26 岁的黄峥。黄峥后来说，这顿饭让他明白了简单和常识的力量；他也把段永平称为自己最重要的导师。

why.en: No money involved for him. The story became a fixed part of his public image and signals the mentor network behind his later ventures, so the reputation coefficient gets a small +1%. The auction closed in late June 2006; the exact day of the lunch is not confirmed, so the date is year precision.
why.zh: 他本人没有任何资金进出。但这个故事成了他公众形象的固定组成部分，也显示出他后来创业背后的导师人脉，口碑系数小幅 +1%。拍卖在 2006 年 6 月底结束，午餐的具体日期无法确认，因此精度为“年”。

src.name: Caixin Global · The Chinese tycoons who won a Buffett lunch (2019-07-25)

t.en: Quits Google and starts the online electronics shop Ouku
t.zh: 从谷歌辞职，创办电商网站欧酷

summary.en: He resigned from Google in 2007 and founded Ouku.com, an online retailer of consumer electronics and home appliances. It was the first of several small companies he ran before Pinduoduo.
summary.zh: 2007 年他从谷歌辞职，创办了销售消费电子和家电的电商网站欧酷网。这是他在拼多多之前经营的几家小公司中的第一家。

why.en: From employee to founder: the human-capital target rises. The financial value of these early ventures is small and only roughly estimated.
why.zh: 从雇员变成创始人，人力资本目标值上调。这些早期项目的财务价值不大，只能粗略估算。

src.name: Wikipedia · Colin Huang
Forbes · Colin Huang profile

t.en: Sells Ouku and moves on to e-commerce services and online games
t.zh: 出售欧酷，转做电商代运营和网络游戏

summary.en: Ouku was sold in 2010, reportedly for about $2.2 million. He went on to run a business that operated online stores for brands and, from 2011, an online games studio called Xinyoudi.
summary.zh: 欧酷在 2010 年被出售，据报道价格约为 220 万美元。此后他先做了为品牌代运营网店的业务，2011 年起又做了网络游戏工作室新游地（Xinyoudi）。

why.en: A modest exit, scored as neutral. The sale price comes from secondary reporting and the private-wealth anchor for these years is a rough estimate.
why.zh: 一次规模不大的退出，记为中性。出售价格来自二手报道，这几年的私有财富锚点是粗略估算。

src.name: Wikipedia · Colin Huang
Forbes · Colin Huang profile

t.en: Launches Pinduoduo, a group-buying marketplace
t.zh: 推出拼团购物平台拼多多

summary.en: Earlier in 2015 he had started Pinhaohuo, which sold fresh fruit directly to shoppers who teamed up for a lower price. In September his games company incubated Pinduoduo, a marketplace that let outside merchants sell the same way, spreading through invitations shared with friends on WeChat.
summary.zh: 2015 年早些时候，他先做了拼好货，让用户拼团低价买水果。同年 9 月，他的游戏公司内部孵化出拼多多：一个让第三方商家用同样方式卖货的平台，靠用户在微信里邀请好友拼单迅速传播。

why.en: The turning point of his life. From here the private series is dominated by his founder stake, valued by interpolating between funding rounds (all estimates). The prospectus confirms that operations began in 2015; the September date comes from secondary reporting.
why.zh: 人生转折点。从这里开始，私有财富序列主要由创始人股权构成，按各轮融资之间插值估算。招股书确认业务始于 2015 年；9 月这一时间来自二手报道。

fin.zh: 创始人股权进入模型（估算）。

src.name: SEC EDGAR · Pinduoduo IPO prospectus (424B4)
Our China Story · The unique philosophy of Pinduoduo's founder Huang Zheng

t.en: Pinhaohuo and Pinduoduo are combined into one company
t.zh: 拼好货与拼多多合并为一家公司

summary.en: In June 2016 the entity behind Pinhaohuo acquired all of the company that ran Pinduoduo, putting the direct-sales business and the marketplace under one roof. The direct-sales side was wound down by early 2017 and the company became a pure marketplace.
summary.zh: 2016 年 6 月，拼好货的运营主体全资收购了拼多多的运营公司，自营业务和平台业务合到了一起。到 2017 年初，自营业务逐步停掉，公司变成纯平台模式。

why.en: A structural step that made the later funding rounds possible. The private anchor for mid-2016 (about $250 million for his stake) is an estimate; round valuations from this period were not officially disclosed.
why.zh: 为之后几轮融资铺路的结构性一步。2016 年年中的私有锚点（他的持股约值 2.5 亿美元）是估算，这一时期的融资估值没有官方披露。

src.name: SEC EDGAR · Pinduoduo IPO prospectus (424B4)

t.en: Series D shares are issued, with Tencent as strategic backer
t.zh: D 轮优先股发行，腾讯成为战略股东

summary.en: Pinduoduo issued its Series D preferred shares, carried in its accounts at about RMB 8.7 billion (roughly $1.4 billion), a few weeks after signing a strategic cooperation agreement with Tencent. The prospectus later listed Tencent as a principal shareholder, and Pinduoduo's access to WeChat traffic and payments was central to its growth.
summary.zh: 在与腾讯签署战略合作框架协议几周后，拼多多发行了 D 轮优先股，账面金额约 87 亿元人民币（约 14 亿美元）。招股书后来把腾讯列为主要股东；微信的流量入口和支付是拼多多增长的关键。

why.en: The last private round before the IPO. The stake anchor of about $5.2 billion is an estimate: his roughly 2.07 billion shares times the price implied by the Series D carrying value. Press reports at the time put the company's valuation as high as about $15 billion.
why.zh: 上市前的最后一轮私募融资。约 52 亿美元的持股锚点为估算：他约 20.7 亿股乘以 D 轮账面金额对应的每股价格。当时媒体报道的公司估值最高约 150 亿美元。

fin.zh: 估算持股价值：约 52 亿美元。

src.name: SEC EDGAR · Pinduoduo IPO prospectus (424B4)
Bloomberg · Ex-Googler's e-commerce site is said valued at about $15 billion (2018-04-12)

t.en: Pinduoduo lists on Nasdaq at $19 per ADS and jumps 40%
t.zh: 拼多多以每份 ADS 19 美元登陆纳斯达克，首日涨四成

summary.en: Less than three years after launch, Pinduoduo raised about $1.6 billion by selling 85.6 million American depositary shares at $19 each. The stock closed its first day at $26.70. Huang kept all the Class B shares, about 46.8% of the company and close to 90% of the votes.
summary.zh: 上线不到三年，拼多多以每份 19 美元的价格发行 8560 万份美国存托股票，募资约 16 亿美元。首日收于 26.70 美元。黄峥持有全部 B 类股，约占公司 46.8% 的股份和近 90% 的投票权。

why.en: Anchor switch: from this day financial capital = ownership × ADS-equivalent shares × the daily close. About 519 million ADS-equivalent shares were worth $9.9 billion at the offer price and about $13.8 billion at the first close.
why.zh: 锚点切换：从这一天起，金融资本 = 持股比例 × 折算 ADS 总数 × 当日收盘价。他约 5.19 亿份折算 ADS 按发行价值约 99 亿美元，按首日收盘价值约 138 亿美元。

fin.en: Priced daily from the PDD quote from here on.
fin.zh: 此后按 PDD 日线逐日计价。

src.name: SEC EDGAR · Pinduoduo IPO prospectus (424B4)
Fortune · A former Google employee just became one of China's richest people (2018-07-27)
Yahoo Finance · PDD price history

t.en: Regulators order a counterfeit-goods probe days after the IPO
t.zh: 上市数日后，监管部门要求调查假货问题

summary.en: After Chinese media reported knock-off and imitation brands on the platform, the State Administration for Market Regulation told Shanghai authorities to investigate. The stock fell about 10% that day and briefly traded below the IPO price. Huang said the company would deal with the problem over time and described it as a stage a growing marketplace goes through.
summary.zh: 国内媒体报道平台上有山寨和傍名牌商品后，国家市场监督管理总局要求上海有关部门展开调查。当天股价下跌约 10%，盘中一度跌破发行价。黄峥表示公司会逐步解决假货问题，并称这是电商平台成长中会经历的阶段。

why.en: The price drop is in the stock. The label of a platform for fakes stuck to the company and its founder for years, which the price alone does not capture, so the reputation coefficient takes -3%.
why.zh: 股价下跌已由股票反映。但“假货平台”的标签此后多年一直贴在公司和创始人身上，这是股价本身反映不了的，因此口碑系数 -3%。

src.name: Caixin Global · Pinduoduo tumbles below IPO price amid fake goods probe (2018-08-02)
Reuters via The Star · China to probe Pinduoduo over reports of counterfeit goods (2018-08-01)

t.en: The U.S. Trade Representative adds Pinduoduo to its Notorious Markets list
t.zh: 美国贸易代表办公室把拼多多列入“恶名市场”名单

summary.en: In April 2019 the Office of the U.S. Trade Representative named Pinduoduo for the first time in its annual list of markets reported to sell counterfeit goods. The platform stayed on the list in later editions.
summary.zh: 2019 年 4 月，美国贸易代表办公室首次把拼多多列入其年度“恶名市场”名单，该名单收录被指销售假冒商品的市场。此后几年拼多多一直在名单上。

why.en: No direct financial effect and little market reaction. It extended the counterfeit criticism to an official foreign list, so the reputation coefficient takes a small -1%.
why.zh: 没有直接的财务影响，市场反应也很小。但假货批评由此延伸到外国官方名单，口碑系数小幅 -1%。

src.name: Wikipedia · Pinduoduo

t.en: Launches the "10 billion yuan subsidies" campaign
t.zh: 推出“百亿补贴”

summary.en: For the June 18 shopping festival Pinduoduo began paying down the prices of branded goods such as iPhones out of its own pocket, often together with the brands. The program became permanent. In the following months the share of orders from large cities rose and monthly active users grew by almost 90% from a year earlier.
summary.zh: 借“618”大促，拼多多开始自掏腰包补贴 iPhone 等品牌商品的售价，不少是和品牌方一起做的。这个项目后来变成常设。此后几个月，来自大城市的订单占比上升，月活跃用户同比增长近九成。

why.en: The move that took the app beyond bargain hunters in small towns and was later copied by its rivals. The financial result is in the share price; a small +1% for changing how the brand was seen.
why.zh: 这一步让拼多多走出了“小城镇便宜货”的圈子，后来被对手纷纷效仿。财务结果已体现在股价里；因为改变了品牌形象，口碑系数小幅 +1%。

src.name: Caixin Global · After conquering the bargain basement, Pinduoduo sets sights on big cities (2019-08-30)

t.en: Hands the CEO job to Chen Lei and gives away a third of his stake
t.zh: 把 CEO 交给陈磊，并转出约三分之一持股

summary.en: Pinduoduo announced that chief technology officer Chen Lei would become CEO while Huang stayed on as chairman. A filing the day before showed his stake had fallen from 43.3% to 29.4%: shares went to a charitable foundation, to the Pinduoduo Partnership to fund science research and management incentives, and, according to press reports, to an early angel investor.
summary.zh: 拼多多宣布由首席技术官陈磊接任 CEO，黄峥留任董事长。前一天的文件显示，他的持股从 43.3% 降到了 29.4%：一部分捐给慈善基金，一部分转给拼多多合伙人集体用于支持科研和管理层激励，另据媒体报道还有一部分转给了早期天使投资人。

why.en: Scored as mixed. The shares he gave away were worth about $14 billion at that day's price and leave his stake for good, so the ownership anchor steps down on this date. The reputation coefficient gets +3% for the scale of the gift and an orderly succession while still about 40.
why.zh: 记为好坏参半。他转出的股份按当天股价约值 140 亿美元，并且永久离开了他名下，所以持股比例锚点在这一天下调。捐赠的规模加上 40 岁上下就完成有序交接，口碑系数 +3%。

fin.en: Stake falls from about 519 million to about 352 million ADS-equivalent shares (roughly $44 billion to $30 billion at the day's close).
fin.zh: 持股从约 5.19 亿份折算 ADS 降到约 3.52 亿份（按当日收盘价，从约 440 亿美元降到约 300 亿美元）。

src.name: SEC EDGAR · Pinduoduo 6-K, management changes (2020-07-01)
Fortune · His wealth surged $25 billion, then he quit as CEO (2020-07-03)

t.en: An employee's death sets off a national debate about overwork
t.zh: 员工去世引发全国性的加班争议

summary.en: Pinduoduo confirmed that an employee in her early twenties had collapsed on the way home after midnight in late December and died. A post from the company's account on a Q&A site, which appeared to shrug off the death, drew wide anger; the company first called it fake and then said a contractor had posted it. Shanghai's labor authority opened an inquiry into working conditions at the company.
summary.zh: 拼多多证实，一名二十出头的女员工 12 月底凌晨下班途中倒地，经抢救无效去世。公司账号在问答网站上发出的一条看似漠视此事的言论激起众怒；公司先称截图不实，后又表示是外包人员发布。上海市劳动保障部门对公司的用工情况展开调查。

why.en: The stock fell about 6% that day, which the price carries. The damage to the company's standing as an employer, and to the image of its founder and chairman, is not in the price, so the reputation coefficient takes -3%. Included as a public corporate matter; nothing beyond what the company and authorities stated is used.
why.zh: 当天股价下跌约 6%，这部分由股价反映。但公司作为雇主的声誉以及创始人兼董事长的形象受到的损害不在股价里，因此口碑系数 -3%。此事作为公司公共事务收录，只采用公司和官方已公开说明的内容。

src.name: Fortune (Bloomberg) · Pinduoduo employee's death renews 996 controversy (2021-01-04)

t.en: Shares reach their record close near $203
t.zh: 股价创下约 203 美元的收盘纪录

summary.en: Pinduoduo's ADS closed at $202.82, more than ten times the IPO price and still the highest close on record. The pandemic had pushed shopping online and the company's user numbers were closing in on Alibaba's.
summary.zh: 拼多多 ADS 收于 202.82 美元，是发行价的十倍多，至今仍是历史最高收盘价。疫情把消费推到线上，公司的用户规模正在逼近阿里巴巴。

why.en: Entirely a market event, so rep = 0. His stake of about 352 million ADS-equivalent shares was worth roughly $71 billion, the peak of his financial capital in this model.
why.zh: 纯市场事件，rep = 0。他约 3.52 亿份折算 ADS 的持股约值 710 亿美元，是本模型中他金融资本的最高点。

src.name: Yahoo Finance · PDD price history

t.en: Pinduoduo passes Alibaba in annual active buyers
t.zh: 拼多多年活跃买家数超过阿里巴巴

summary.en: Fourth-quarter results showed 788.4 million people had bought on Pinduoduo during 2020, up 35% in a year and ahead of the 779 million Alibaba reported for its Chinese shopping sites. It made the five-year-old company the country's largest e-commerce platform by number of customers.

summary.en: A U.S. executive order ended the "de minimis" exemption, which had let parcels worth $800 or less enter duty-free, for goods from mainland China and Hong Kong from May 2, 2025. why.en: A policy shock to Temu's largest market. The stock fell about 12% over the next two sessions, during a broad tariff sell-off, and the price carries the effect, so rep = 0.
